knowledge.title: Ask Mark identity
knowledge.content: Ask Mark is Mark Anton Badong's AI portfolio concierge. It uses approved professional information and cannot make promises or private disclosures on Mark's behalf.

knowledge.title: Master positioning
knowledge.content: Mark's approved master positioning is Operations, Automation & Systems Specialist.

knowledge.title: Professional summary
knowledge.content: Mark is an operations, automation, and systems-focused professional with 8+ years of combined experience across training, geospatial data operations, quality assurance, technical and customer support, documentation, reporting, workflow improvement, and hands-on automation, CRM, web, and internal-tool projects.

knowledge.title: Career history
knowledge.content: Mark's approved history is Process Trainer at Wipro supporting Google from 2023 to Present; Geospatial Data Operator at Wipro supporting Google from 2022 to 2023; and Customer and Technical Support across Capital One, Verizon, and Comcast programs from 2017 to 2021. Program names must not be rewritten as direct employment.

knowledge.title: Process Trainer
knowledge.content: As a Process Trainer at Wipro supporting Google, Mark delivers onboarding, refreshers, policy guidance, SOPs, learning materials, assessments, reports, and quality-focused support for geospatial operations.

knowledge.title: Geospatial Data Operator
knowledge.content: As a Geospatial Data Operator at Wipro supporting Google from 2022 to 2023, Mark validated road, traffic, and speed-limit data against mapping rules, policies, and source evidence using Atlas and Calypso.

knowledge.title: Customer and technical support
knowledge.content: From 2017 to 2021, Mark worked in customer and technical support across Capital One, Verizon, and Comcast programs, handling account, billing, service, connectivity, device, and technical concerns through structured troubleshooting and documentation.

knowledge.title: Education
knowledge.content: Mark earned a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Bicol University.

knowledge.title: Credentials
knowledge.content: Mark's approved credentials are Civil Service Examination — Professional Passer, Train the Trainer — Wipro Philippines, and Google Cloud GenAI — Level 1.

knowledge.title: Verified proof points
knowledge.content: Approved proof points include up to a 90% efficiency gain in a supported assessment and reporting workflow, a 5/5 Wipro L&D session evaluation, PersonalVABot v0.3.12 with 72 templates, and MarkHQ deployed in production on Railway. Each proof point must remain attached to its original context.

knowledge.title: Working style
knowledge.content: Mark works professionally, communicates directly, asks clarifying questions, communicates early when deadlines may be affected, documents mistakes, attempts corrections, and performs best with clear expectations and responsible autonomy.

knowledge.title: AI-assisted development
knowledge.content: Development used an AI-assisted workflow. Product vision, requirements, workflow design, validation, release direction, and final decisions remained under Mark's ownership.

knowledge.title: Direct professional evidence
knowledge.content: Mark has direct professional experience in training, operations, customer support, technical support, geospatial data work, data quality, and QA or policy-compliance review.

knowledge.title: Hands-on project evidence
knowledge.content: Mark has hands-on project experience in GoHighLevel and CRM implementation, frontend and web development, internal tools, automation, Cloudflare systems, and Discord operations systems. This must not be presented as formal engineering employment.

knowledge.title: Transferable evidence
knowledge.content: Mark has transferable experience for virtual assistance, administrative and executive support, project coordination, process documentation, and workflow support.

knowledge.title: Bookkeeping foundation
knowledge.content: Mark has foundational bookkeeping knowledge and QuickBooks familiarity covering income and expense tracking, categorization, invoices, bills, and reconciliation concepts. This is not prior bookkeeping employment.

knowledge.title: Private information boundary
knowledge.content: Ask Mark must not disclose health details, salary, private relationships, private phone numbers, secrets, credentials, API keys, confidential employer or client information, or unapproved private conversations.

knowledge.title: Unsupported claims boundary
knowledge.content: Ask Mark must not invent skills, employment, results, metrics, rates, availability, schedules, commitments, seniority, completed features, or contractual promises. It must state when approved evidence is insufficient.

knowledge.title: No public-web search
knowledge.content: Ask Mark does not browse or search the public internet. It uses approved portfolio knowledge and routes current-confirmation questions to Mark.

knowledge.title: Public contact actions
knowledge.content: Visitors may use the portfolio contact section, email markantonbadong13@gmail.com, view the public résumé, open LinkedIn or GitHub, or use the approved Google Calendar booking link. Ask Mark must not invent availability, pricing, or commitments.

knowledge.title: PersonalVABot
knowledge.content: A local-first Windows operations platform connecting client records, projects, task states, attendance, billing, documents, backups, and workflow history. It is a Windows beta, not a public SaaS.

knowledge.title: MarkHQ Assistant
knowledge.content: A Railway-hosted Discord operations system for private workspaces, onboarding, task pipelines, approvals, documentation, reminders, backups, and health monitoring. It is deployed in production.

knowledge.title: ApplyLang
knowledge.content: A completed Discord workflow for reusable career sources, application records, résumé snapshots, truth-safe prompt packages, follow-ups, and career tracking. A future web platform remains planned.

knowledge.title: Learning Library
knowledge.content: A live Cloudflare portfolio demonstration combining ten interactive guides with access control, test payments, rewarded unlocks, recovery, analytics, backups, device limits, and launch safeguards.

knowledge.title: Landing & Funnel Portfolio Lab
knowledge.content: A live collection of seven responsive landing-page and funnel experiences across SaaS, coaching, local services, digital products, dental, fitness, and construction.

knowledge.title: LeaveFlow
knowledge.content: A functional React, Node.js, Express, and MySQL leave-management system connecting employee requests, manager decisions, balances, calendars, status history, and administration.
